icon_concept: a network node with a looping arrow

icon_concept: a beacon with concentric light rings rising from a rounded square

icon_concept: an atlas globe with node points on its meridians

icon_concept: a lens ring with a speech notch

icon_concept: a key silhouette crossed by a redaction bar
